review: Official source and fixed 33x320x320 input, reverse 24 through 9, 81 stride32 patches retained.
First three saved CPU predictions gate the remaining 78; no warmup, no new CT, no second run.
Ownership is distinct from requested configuration: wrong configuration can be cleaned up.
One create POST, preexisting-name check and recorded absolute deadline, no create retry.
Local admin credential stays local; Pod watchdog uses only provider-injected own-Pod credential.
Worker drops Pod credential; logs and result archive exclude credentials and input/weight payloads.
User authorization is still required before approved-run. No payment or execution was authorized by this review.

visual_review.observation: Published Hecate has high-contrast bright areas at upper center and lower right, broadly corresponding to the existing two models. This is a partial known-control crop, not an independent reading or a new discovery.
visual_review.decision: Useful as a fixed reproduction reference, not evidence of better recognition accuracy.

unverified: Live Pod creation, exec transfer, local-to-remote environment behavior and GPU runtime.
Pod-scoped credential DELETE authority; a successful GET cannot prove it.
Provider failures can prevent deletion; USD0.50 and 20 minutes are operational limits, not enforced provider caps.
Current account credit and auto-reload conditions must be checked before launch without changing them.
result: Preparation is reviewable for one approval request; no claim of a tested cloud run.
